items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewee mentions Monk only in the context of asking about other musicians ('What about the other boy that was with Monk?') and referencing Nica's connection to Monk. No direct personal interaction or collaboration between Jimmy Cobb and Thelonious Monk is described.

ctx.x: I heard somewhere that was – might have been in line to get Ron’s slot, what became Ron Carter’s slot.
He could have been. He’s a pretty good bass player. What about the other boy that was with Monk?
